comments.author: Shaz
comments.body_html:
Welp, i would have loved to drop a review but it isn’t possible (yet?).

This mod looks simple from a user perspective, but it a brilliant idea that definitely changes the way the game is played. I played EFT and SPT for hours and I just learnt new loose loot spawn with this. Done with the lost backpack in the grass, done with looking for the long range kill’s body on woods for minutes, done with searching empty containers (idk if it’s a bug or a feature yet), done with the loose loot you didn’t see because it clipped through the ground or just dropped in front of the usual spawn.

I would love to see a parallel mod for a way of progression in sense (tied to attention skill?), making it a larger radius and having the icons stay longer with the player getting better at using his 6th sense!

Anyway, it is the 3rd mod that definitely changed my Tarkov experience, and it’s the 3rd Amands’ mod non the less…
Hats down!

comments.author: Amands2Mello
comments.body_html:
Lootable containers have a default color that only Rare, Wishlist, Nonflea and Kappa items can override.
Normal items colors don’t show through the container color because they all have the same priority.
